title: 52 Week Three #3 DC Comics 2006 Lex Luthor J.G. Jones Cover Power Girl
condition_description: Bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
52 Week Three (#3, May 24 2006), DC Comics - "Lex Luthor: The Fall and Rise of an American Icon." J.G. Jones painted cover. Power Girl unleashed, the King of Kahndaq and Midnight in the House of Irons; plus The History of the DC Universe backup by Dan Jurgens and Art Thibert. Direct sales, $2.50 cover price.

Back cover: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Legend ad.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
